title: Spread operator in JSX element crashes ESLint

labels.name: archived due to age

body:
This code:

``` javascript
var React = require('react/addons');

module.exports = React.createClass({
  render: function() {
    return <div {...this.props} />;
  }
});
```

Crashes ESLint and generates this stack trace:
